character: Consistent anime teen boy with messy dark hair and black gym shorts across all scenes.
no_text: NO words, sentences, subtitles or UI drawn anywhere (graphic numbers/counters the shots ask for, glows, arrows and ruler ticks are fine).
pose: Standard standing, punching upward, and pointing gestures without unnatural posture.
anatomy: Close-ups tightly framed on abdomen or jawline without headless neck stumps or warped limbs.
voice: The voiceover says the expected text passed separately (minor wording differences allowed).
narration: The character never talks or lip-syncs; the voice is off-screen narration.
